audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven full-layer phases[N].side rows disagreed with content win[N]. Full read Taliyah/Skill/Skill/Skill/Malzahar/Skill/Skill; content and the packet levelChart both read Skill/Taliyah/Taliyah/Taliyah/Malzahar/Malzahar/Malzahar.
audit.why: The content whys[] are grounded and match the packet: Taliyah owns 2 through 5 on Threaded Volley push plus Unraveled Earth zoning, and Malzahar owns 6 onward. The full layer carried the stale blanket.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to match, each why rewritten in the same proposal. win[N] left alone — it already holds the target values, so a paired edit would be a no-op.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5] and phases[6] read Skill while both the packet and content give first item and two items to Malzahar; the whys were generic Malzahar boilerplate that named no Taliyah mechanic.
audit.why: Weaver's Wall is 180/150/120s and is a roam tool that leaves lane, so her spike is a map spike, not a duel spike; Malzahar's voidling shove plus a 700-range point-and-click R answers a poke-and-pick kit with no self-peel.
audit.corrected: Both whys rewritten to state the actual reason those rows flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never stated that Taliyah cancels Nether Grasp, and it invented "Iron Boundary" for Malzahar's passive (real name Void Shift).
audit.why: Nether Grasp is a channel and any CC cancels it (kit flag: channel, interruptible). Taliyah carries hardCC on Threaded Volley, Unraveled Earth and Weaver's Wall — three separate cancels. This is the single most important interaction in the matchup and packet.defects confirms zero sequencing cues existed anywhere.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d and breakdown.carry now say to channel only after one of her CC casts is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT on breakdown.cooldowns, and packet.defects reports zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: Seismic Shove 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s, Threaded Volley 7/6/5/4/3s, Unraveled Earth 14s flat, Weaver's Wall 180/150/120s — none of it was on the page.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with all of it plus the channel-cancel sequencing rule.

edits.before: Lost Chapter and the machine is complete: E-hops fund themselves, the wave is always crashing, and his tower is always bleeding.

edits.before: Late Malz is a number: one suppression on their carry equals one won teamfight. Shield up, flank smart, press R.
edits.after: Two items in she has no self-peel once you are on her — suppression beats a poke-and-pick kit cleanly. Yours.

edits.before: - Taliyah Seismic Shove: matchup-defining — The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget spell shield (Iron Boundary) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Seismic Shove is 14s at rank 1 and 8s at rank 5 — step up on its downtime. - Threaded Volley falls from 7s to 3s, so the poke never really stops. - Unraveled Earth is a flat 14s. Any of those CC casts cancels your Nether Grasp, so channel only once one is spent.
